description: The plot illustrates the performance of three different methods - On-policy RL, LUFFY, and SFT - with respect to temperature, measured by Accuracy (Pass@8). The x-axis represents temperature, with a linear scale ranging from 0.1 to 1.0, and tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The y-axis represents Accuracy (Pass@8), with a linear scale ranging from 62.5 to 80.0, and tick labels at intervals of 2.5. The On-policy RL line is orange with triangle markers and a solid line style, starting at around 62.5 at a temperature of 0.1, dropping to around 67.5 at 0.2, then fluctuating between around 67.5 and 72.5 before rising to around 72.5 at a temperature of 1.0. The LUFFY line is red with star markers and a solid line style, starting at around 75.0 at a temperature of 0.1, rising to around 77.5 at 0.2, then generally increasing to around 80.6 at a temperature of 1.0, with some fluctuations in between. The SFT line is blue with triangle markers and a solid line style, starting at around 75.0 at a temperature of 0.1, decreasing to around 72.5 at 0.3, then generally decreasing to around 72.5 at 0.7 before rising to around 74.0 at a temperature of 1.0, with some fluctuations in between.
